en_US.title: True Cause Knowledge Tiers
en_US.scanner: True-cause knowledge was tiered across risk, Atlas weighting, evacuation law, insurance and recovery offices.
en_US.field_note: This keeps Deep Reach guilty without making every worker omniscient or every executive a cartoon villain.
en_US.terminal: KNOWLEDGE TIERS: field staff saw tide anomalies; risk office accepted tail margins; Atlas office weighted continuity; evacuation counsel delayed releases; Keelmark converted losses; Recovery Compliance wants payload before truth.
en_US.audio: No one wrote murder. They wrote columns until rescue lost.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Deep Reach did not need one mastermind. The disaster became fatal through distributed categories and delayed authority.
en_US.external_site: True Cause Knowledge Tiers define who inside Deep Reach knew which part of the HECTON-8 failure chain.

en_US.title: Liability Memo Fragment Chain
en_US.scanner: Liability memos must be fragments that match physical rooms, not lore speeches.
en_US.field_note: A useful memo names one margin, one delay, one office and one visible consequence.
en_US.terminal: MEMO CHAIN: tide margin note, Atlas priority waiver, evacuation hold, loss conversion, packet notary seal and present return-action clause. A single memo is suspicion. The chain is evidence.
en_US.audio: Paper is weak alone. Put it against a flooded door.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Liability memo fragments teach players to cross-check corporate language against damaged rooms and worker evidence.
en_US.external_site: Liability Memo Fragment Chain defines how Deep Reach evidence works in HECTON-8.

en_US.title: Signoff Witness Conflict
en_US.scanner: Signoff records should contradict worker witness hashes and damaged evacuation hardware.
en_US.field_note: The contradiction is stronger than a villain confession because the player sees the room and the stamp disagree.
en_US.terminal: CONFLICT: Varnek margin accepted before field alarms closed; Arendt weighting preserved Atlas lanes; Haldane hold delayed external evacuation; worker witness hash reports pump access still occupied.
en_US.audio: The signatures line up. The bodies do not.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Signoff conflict evidence makes the Deep Reach lie break through records, room damage and worker traces.
en_US.external_site: Signoff Witness Conflict defines the evidence contradiction behind the public Deep Reach report.

en_US.title: Suboffice Personnel Seeds
en_US.scanner: Lower Deep Reach personnel names should be seeded signatures tied to office function.
en_US.field_note: Use names only when they make a memo, stamp, badge or order more playable.
en_US.terminal: PERSONNEL SEED RULE: Contract Desk, Packet Notary, Quarantine Gate, Asset Silence Board and Return Queue may generate local signatures. They do not replace Varnek/Arendt/Haldane/Ibarra/Sato-Ren.
en_US.audio: A clerk can damage a life without owning the whole disaster.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Suboffice personnel seeds let future missions add human texture without inventing a new villain hierarchy.
en_US.external_site: Suboffice Personnel Seeds define how lower Deep Reach names can appear in future content.

en_US.title: False Public Report Packet
en_US.scanner: The public lie says storm, geotechnical collapse, failed evacuation, corrupted Atlas logs and quarantine loss.
en_US.field_note: The strongest lie is mostly true. It removes weighting, margin and delay.
en_US.terminal: PUBLIC REPORT: Great Tide geotechnical cascade; autonomous evacuation failure; Atlas stabilization corruption; biological and pressure quarantine; data loss. REDACTED: accepted tail margin, continuity weighting, release delay, insurance conversion.
en_US.audio: They did not fake the storm. They buried the choice.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The false public report works because HECTON-8 physics really was catastrophic; Deep Reach erased the human decisions inside that physics.
en_US.external_site: False Public Report Packet states the Deep Reach public version and the hidden omissions.
